```{r load}
library("ape")
library("phangorn")
library("ggplot2")
source("utils.R")
source("evaluate_tree.R")
mp_fun <- function(x) {
  mm_start <- NJ(dist.hamming(x))
  trees = pratchet(x, start = mm_start, minit = 10, maxit = 10000, all = TRUE, trace = 0, method = "fitch", rearrangements = "SPR", perturbation = "ratchet")
  if (inherits(trees, "multiPhylo")) {
    trees <- ape::consensus(trees, p = 1)
  }
  trees
}
```

# Maximum parsimony


```{r benchmark_pestimate, echo=FALSE}
source("mp.R")
results_mp = NULL
n = 99
#n = 10
pb = txtProgressBar(min = 0, max = n, style = 3)
for(i in 0:n){
  setTxtProgressBar(pb, i)
  attempt <- tryCatch({
    # Load data and gt tree
    simu_data = load_simu_data(file = paste("simulations_data/simulated_traditions_22_07/sequences_", i, ".nex", sep = ""), return_dates=FALSE)
    data = simu_data$data
    ### Then GT, without forgetting the 0-length edge conversion
    gt <- convert_gt_internal_nodes(file=paste("simulations_data/simulated_traditions_22_07/tree_", i, ".newick", sep = ""))
  }, error = function(e) {
    # Print a warning showing which file failed
    message(sprintf("Skipping iteration %d due to error: %s", i, e$message))
    return(NULL)
  })
  
  # --- 2. Skip to next iteration if loading failed ---
  if (is.null(attempt)) {
    next
  }
  # Perform analyses
  dm <- dist.hamming(data)
  treeNJ<- NJ(dm)
  mm_start <- treeNJ
  # Applying the pratchet method for maximum parsimony
  ew_pratchet <- pratchet(data, start = mm_start, minit = 10, maxit = 10000, all = TRUE, trace = 0, method = "fitch", rearrangements = "SPR", perturbation = "ratchet")
  ew_bab = phangorn::bab(data, trace = 0)
  #ew_enum <- mpt_enumerate(data)
  #if(!same_tree_sets(ew_enum, ew_bab)){
  #  warning("Difference observed between bab and enumeration")
  #}
  ## And now implied weights
  data_iw = clean_phydat_attributes(data)
  rooted_trees <- TreeTools::RootTree(all_topologies(data), 1)
  sweep <- mpt_sweep(
    data_iw, 
    k_grid = c(2, 3, 10, 20), 
    trees = rooted_trees
    )
  ## And BS
  bs_trees <- bootstrap.phyDat(data, FUN = mp_fun, bs = 100)
  mm_tree_BS <- ape::consensus(bs_trees, p = 0.5)
  
  ## Now score everything
  preds <- list(
    EW_pratchet = ape::consensus(ew_pratchet, p=1),
    EW_bab  = ape::consensus(ew_bab, p=1),
    #EW_enum = ape::consensus(ew_enum, p=1),
    IW_k2   = ape::consensus(sweep$k2, p=1),
    IW_k3   = ape::consensus(sweep$k3, p=1),
    #IW_k5   = ape::consensus(sweep$k5, p=1),
    IW_k10  = ape::consensus(sweep$k10, p=1),
    IW_k20  = ape::consensus(sweep$k20, p=1),
    #IW_inf  = ape::consensus(sweep$kInf, p=1)
    MP_BS   = mm_tree_BS
  )
  # And now results
  results_mp <- rbind(results_mp, score_methods(preds, gt, tradition = i))
}
write.csv("results_mp.csv", results_mp)
```

```{r}
default_methods <- c(
  MP_SC     = "MP EW",
  MP_IW_SC  = "MP (IW, SC)",
  EW_pratchet       = "EW (pratchet)",
  EW_bab            = "EW (bab)",
  EW_enum           = "EW (enum)",
  IW_k2   = "IW (k=2)",
  IW_k3   = "IW (k=3)",
  IW_k10  = "IW (k=10)",
  IW_k20  = "IW (k=20)",
  MP_BS   = "EW (pratchet) BS-50%MRC"
)
```



```{r plotQuartet_pestimate}
plot_metric_boxplots(results_mp, "quartet_div", ylab = "quartet  divergence", title = "Unrooted point estimate trees quartet divergence to GT", subtitle = "(families)", methods = default_methods)
```

```{r plotGRF_pestimate}
plot_metric_boxplots(results_mp, "cid", ylab = "gRF  dissimilarity", title = "Unrooted point estimate trees gRF distance to GT", subtitle = "(Topology)", methods = default_methods)
```

```{r}
custom_names = c(
  EW_pratchet    = "EW pratchet",
  EW_bab     = "EW bab",
  IW_k2       = "IW k=2",
  IW_k3       = "IW k=3",
  IW_k10      = "IW k=10",
  IW_k20      = "IW k=20"
  )
library("patchwork")
pA = plot_metric_boxplots(results_mp, "quartet_div", ylab = "quartet  divergence", methods = custom_names)
pB = plot_metric_boxplots(results_mp, "cid", ylab = "gRF  dissimilarity", methods = custom_names)

fig <- wrap_plots(
  pA, pB,
  ncol = 2,
  nrow = 1
) +
  plot_layout(ncol = 2, nrow = 1) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A") &
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 12),          # Scales all text (axes, legends, titles)
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),    # Axis labels
    axis.text = element_text(size = 11),     # Tick labels
    plot.tag = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold") # A-F tags
  ) & coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 0.85))
fig
ggsave("MP_benchmark.png", fig, width = 12, height = 6, dpi = 300) 

```
